note: Pre-registered specification for Phase 7: Signal Edge & Trade Selection Validation. Evaluates whether deterministic pre-trade context filtering creates conditional edge over the TAKE_ALL baseline. All thresholds, feature definitions, validation gates, and comparison rules must be frozen before TEST evaluation.

trend.description: Distance from price to SMA20 in percent
Absolute distance from price to SMA50 normalized by ATR14
Normalized position of price in recent 20-bar high-low range

momentum.description: Difference between recent 5-bar return and prior 5-bar return
Whether 5-bar and 20-bar returns share the same sign

volatility.description: Ratio of 14-bar ATR to 50-bar ATR (>1 indicates expansion)
Quintile rank of ATR14 over prior 100 bars (1=lowest, 5=highest)

marketStructure.description: Current bar range divided by 14-bar ATR
Bar body size divided by total bar range
Minimum distance to 20-bar high or low as percent
Count of return sign flips over last 10 bars

liquidityCost.description: Expected move divided by round-trip transaction friction

confirmation.description: Number of other strategies generating matching-side signals at the same bar
Whether candidate signal side aligns with trend_direction

selectionRules.description: Admit all candidate signals without filtering (CONTROL baseline)
Admit only if candidate side aligns with trend direction (trend_agree === true)
Admit if trend_agree is true AND trend_strength >= 1.0
Admit if vol_expansion >= 1.0 (ATR14 expands above 50-bar baseline)
Admit if vol_percentile >= 3 (upper 60% of 100-bar volatility history)
Admit if move_to_cost_ratio >= 2.0 (expected move at least 2x friction)
Admit if move_to_cost_ratio >= 3.0 (expected move at least 3x friction)
Admit if multi_horizon_agree is true and matches trade side
Admit if range_expansion >= 1.0 (current bar range expands above ATR14)
Admit if strategy_agreement_count >= 1 (at least 1 other strategy agrees on side)
Admit if trend_agree is true AND vol_expansion >= 1.0
Admit if trend_agree is true AND move_to_cost_ratio >= 2.0
Admit if trend_agree is true AND move_to_cost_ratio >= 2.0 AND vol_percentile >= 3

profitabilityGuard: PROFITABILITY: NOT VERIFIED. Under the project charter, neither single-trade return, backtest results, nor offline candidate selection constitute verified live profitability.
